articles.summary: Six-month experience combines technical learning, hands-on challenges and cultural exploration PHOENIX Hackster.io, an Avnet community, in collaboration with Renesas, has launched Journey Around Japan, a six-month developer engagement program designed to help engineers expand their knowledge of Renesas technologies through interactive learning experiences inspired by regions across Japan. Hosted by the Hackster community, the program combines technical education, hands-on activities and community engagement to help developers build practical skills while virtually exploring some of Japans most iconic destinations. Over six months, participants will complete challenges, quizzes, virtual labs and other interactive experiences focused on the Renesas ecosystem. At Hackster, were always looking for new ways to make technical learning more engaging and accessible, said Dianne Kibbey, Senior Director, Community Strategy and Hackster.io at Avnet.

articles.summary: Conference call and webcast to follow at 9:00 a.m. PT / Noon ET Avnet, Inc. (Nasdaq: AVT ), a leading global technology distributor and solutions provider, today announced it will report financial results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026 on August 5, 2026 before the market opens. Following the earnings release, Avnet’s Chief Executive Officer Phil Gallagher and Chief Financial Officer Ken Jacobson will host a webcast and conference call at 9:00 a.m. PT / Noon ET to discuss the financial results and provide a corporate update. Avnet’s Board has also scheduled the Annual Meeting of Shareholders for Friday, November 20, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. Phoenix, Arizona time. The meeting will be held at Avnet’s Corporate Headquarters located at: 2150 E. Warner Road, Tempe, Arizona 85284. The record date for determining the common shareholders entitled to vote at the meeting has been set at the close of business on September 21, 2026.
